page.layout: One main text column with a diagram-like brace at the top; a narrow sliver of the facing right page at the right edge (partially visible, cropped text fragments such as "ful", "He", "per", "eft", "effe", "Pro", "tion", "aequ", "vnâ", "conf" which belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed). Running head at top left and page number at top centre. Margin notes in the text block are scripture references inline (printed as part of the lines in the left column area).

main_text.p: Effentiales funt vt in anima,(a)humanus intelleſctus,voluntas, memoria, humanæ affectiones: (b) In corpore, soliditas, circumscriptio, conformatio iusta partis extra partem . (a) Luc.2. 47. Math. 27.39. Luc.3.21. (b) Luc.24.39. Marc. 16.19. Act. 1.9.11.Luc.21.27.Math.24.30.& 25.31.Luc.22.69.Act. 7.55.& 3.21.

Infirmitatis funt, Tum in anima, vt ignorantia siue peccato.Mar.13.32.Ignorantia quorundam donec fenfu cognoscuntur. Marc.11.13. augmentum sapientiæ & gratiæ apud Deum & homines. Luc. 2.52. Memoriæ infirmitas ex omnium facultatum concussione, dolores, metus, triftitiæ. Math. 27. 37.38.39. & 27.46. Heb. 5.7. Dilectio specialis erga personam aliquam. Marc. 10. 21. Admiratio. Marc. 6. 6. animi commotio, ira, perturbatio sui-ipsius, fremitus spiritus. Math. 9. 39. Marc.3. 5. Ioha.11.33. 38. Indignatio. Marc. 10.14.Tum in corpore, conceptio, & natiuitas, excepto peccato nostri similis, augmentum staturæ, defatigatio, furies, dolor, lachrymæ,mors. Luc.2. 52. Ioh. 4.6.Mat.4.2. Heb.5.7.

Gloriæ proprietates, vt in anima,sapientia, cognitio,potentia creata,etsi deitatis,inæqualis;nobis tamen incomprehensibilis, omnes creaturas superans. In corpore, immortalitas, gloria maxima cœlestis, fulgor.

page.notes: Marginal scripture references are printed inline within the text lines in this transcription; the diagram braces at the top are rendered as their labels. Right-edge fragments belong to the facing page and were omitted. Some letters in the upper-left brace area are uncertain.
